name: EZ-Restaurant (EZRestro)
tagline: Scan. Order. Enjoy. AI-Powered QR Restaurant Management & Ordering SaaS Platform
description: EZ-Restaurant is an enterprise-grade, multi-tenant SaaS platform engineered to modernize traditional restaurant operations into a seamless, digital-first workflow. Customers scan table-specific QR codes to browse interactive AI-assisted menus, customize orders, call waiters, and request bills directly from their smartphones. Kitchen staff and managers receive real-time WebSocket order streams via an intuitive Kitchen Display System (KDS) with audio alerts, live order tracking, and comprehensive sales analytics.
keyFeatures: Contactless Customer Web App: Zero app download, table-aware QR code scanning & live order tracking
Gemini AI Culinary Assistant: Instant dietary recommendations, wine pairings & dish explanations
Kitchen Display System (KDS): Live WebSocket order streams, acoustic audio alerts & Kanban workflow
Digital Waiter Bell & Request Bill: One-tap table alerts with instant sound notifications for staff
Manager Dashboard: Visual sales analytics, Recharts peak hour trends & menu CRUD management
Table & QR Code Generator: Instant table-specific QR code asset generation & printing
Multi-Tenant Super Admin Oversight: Global tenant onboarding, subscription tiers & platform health metrics
High-Security Architecture: RBAC permissions, JWT auth, HTTP-only cookies & rate limiting

name: MSG (Ethnic Fashion & Merchant OS)
tagline: Luxury Ethnic Wear E-Commerce Platform & Merchant Operating System
description: MSG is a custom-built, full-stack E-Commerce platform tailored for high-end luxury ladies' ethnic wear (Sarees, Salwar Suits, Lehengas, Kurtis, and Dupattas). Styled in Royal Matte Crimson Red (#9B1B30) & Antique Gold (#D4AF37), it bridges traditional retail charm with digital-first convenience by offering a high-performance Customer Storefront alongside an intuitive Merchant Administration & Analytics Dashboard.
keyFeatures: Bespoke Luxury UI/UX: Royal Matte Crimson (#9B1B30) & Antique Gold (#D4AF37) palette with Fraunces typography
Smart Catalog & Discovery: Specialized categories (Banarasi, Kanjivaram, Anarkali, Bridal Lehengas) with stock badges
Flexible Checkout Flow: Home Delivery or In-Store Reserve & Pickup with Cash / Pay Later options
Boutique Till-Receipt Order Tracking: Receipt-style order timeline with live fulfillment status & payment links
Merchant Operating System: Real-time sales analytics (Today, Week, Month, All-Time) with 7-day trend graphs
Full Inventory & Category Engine: Complete CRUD for products, discount pricing schedules, stock & campaign badges
Customer Relationship CRM: Tracks Customer Lifetime Value (LTV), total purchase volume & order counts
Promotional Banner Ads Manager: Dynamic ad engine to create, schedule & display banner ads on storefront

name: AI Studio (Gemini 2.0 Flash Tool)
tagline: Accelerate Innovation with Gemini 2.0 Flash Powered Intelligence
description: AI Studio is a cutting-edge web application designed by AiKodX to provide users with a fast, modern, and interactive interface for Google's Gemini 2.0 Flash AI model. It provides real-time answers, writes complex code snippets, formats technical markdown, and persists chat sessions—delivering an exceptional user experience on both desktop and mobile devices.
keyFeatures: Gemini 2.0 Flash Core Reasoning: Handles multi-turn complex queries (<1.2s latency) for coding, math & business strategy
Code Syntax Highlighting & Copy Badges: Dracula-styled code boxes for JS, Python, TS, HTML, CSS & C++
Persistent Prompt History: Stores up to 30 past search sessions in localStorage with 1-click prompt rerun
Smart Workspace & Mobile Drawer: Touch-friendly slide-over drawer with backdrop blur overlay for mobile
Dark & Light Mode Switcher: Automatic OS theme detection with manual browser memory toggle
Markdown & Formatting Engine: Custom regex heading polishers & React Markdown parsing

name: ReadyGo (Ride Sharing & Hub Platform)
tagline: Connecting commuters & travellers with smart 50km hub proximity matching
description: ReadyGo is an eco-friendly intercity ride-sharing and commuting web platform designed to eliminate single-occupancy vehicle waste. Drivers offer empty seats on planned routes while passengers search and connect with nearby rides using a 50km hub proximity geofencing algorithm. Featuring dual driver/passenger portals, MySQL transactional storage, and direct hotline coordination.
keyFeatures: Dual Role Portals: Dedicated Rider/Driver portal (rindex.html) & Traveller/Passenger portal (pindex.html)
50km Hub Proximity Geofencing: Automatically filters and matches origins/destinations within a 50km radius constraint
Ride Publication Engine: Form submission capturing Driver Name, Phone, Available Seats, Vehicle Type & Travel Schedule
Ride Search & Matching Query: Dynamic SQL lookup filtering active drivers by route, date, and seat availability
Direct Coordination & Hotline: One-click phone connectivity plus central dispatch helpline (+91 8445178177)
Multi-Modal Vehicle Support: Handles motorbikes, personal cars, and mass transit buses effortlessly

name: Dropizi Courier (Hub Parcel Delivery System)
tagline: Next-generation hub-based parcel dispatch & intercity delivery network
description: Dropizi Courier is an enterprise-grade, hub-based parcel delivery system designed for seamless intercity package logistics. Featuring a 50km hub proximity geofence algorithm, Dropizi routes parcel packages between interconnected regional hubs and traveler routes, offering real-time shipment tracking, automated dispatch management, and low-latency delivery status updates.
keyFeatures: 50km Hub Proximity Geofencing: Smart parcel routing between local pickup & destination hubs within 50km radius
Real-Time Package Tracking Timeline: Live status progression (Order Confirmed → Picked Up → Hub Arrived → Dispatched → Delivered)
Interactive Parcel Dispatch Hub: Single-pane dashboard for hub operators, parcel manifests & route optimization
Driver & Courier Portal: Mobile-optimized dispatch dashboard for line-haul drivers & last-mile couriers
Automated Sound & Push Notifications: Instant acoustic & SMS/WhatsApp alerts upon hub arrival and delivery
Multi-Tenant Hub Management: Role-based permissions for Hub Managers, Logistics Dispatchers & System Admins
